items.title: LA First-Come · Los Angeles · 1 units · deadline 2026-12-15
items.en_title: Los Angeles first-come deadline December 15: only 1 affordable rental left
items.en_oneliner: Just 1 home left, first-come not a lottery, closing December 15. Best for households whose paperwork is already ready.

items.title: Boston Lottery · Plymouth · 8 units · deadline 2026-12-15
items.en_title: Plymouth lottery closes Dec 15: 8 homes on the South Shore
items.en_oneliner: Plymouth's lottery closes Dec 15 with 8 homes; the South Shore town costs less to live in than central Boston, and applicants willing to live farther out usually face lighter competition.

items.title: Bay Area First-Come · Santa Rosa · 6 units · deadline 2026-12-15
items.en_title: Santa Rosa first-come closes December 15: 6 family-sized affordable rentals
items.en_oneliner: Six Santa Rosa rentals, all two- and three-bedrooms, close December 15, first-come — family-sized openings are scarce in the North Bay, so households with kids should move early.
